blurb: You'll make forever memories when you learn to line dance in the heart of Music City! Our classes are held in historic and authentic Honky Tonks right on Broadway in downtown Nashville. We offer COUNTRY line dances you can do everywhere and a unique honky tonk experience that you won't find anywhere else and immerses you into the world and culture of Country Music & line dancing entertainment! We fell in love with dancing and we want to share our love of dancing with our guests. We strive to give you the confidence to own the dance floor. We want to make you feel good and look good! Our motto is 'Fake It Til You Make It' - and our #1 goal is that you have FUN!
